caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular rug with a wide bluish-gray border surrounding the entire edge. Inside this border is an ornate reddish-brown scrolling vine pattern that frames the inner area. In the center of the rug, there is a dense cluster of flowers in different shapes and colors, including red, pink, purple, white, and brown, with various green leaves interspersed throughout. Some smaller yellow and white buds and sprigs also appear in the floral arrangement. The background of the central area of the rug is a pale, muted gray-green color, creating a contrast with the more vibrant colors of the flowers and the border. The image also includes a small, handwritten text in the lower left corner with the inscription "1'5 x 3' E. VALENTINE."
title: Hooked Rug
